climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A California AVA around the town of Tehachapi in Kern County, between the Tehachapi Mountains and the southern Sierra Nevada. It is small, with six vineyards on 25 acres in 2020, and no other AVA lies within 75 miles.
